song.title: ’Twas the Tism, M’Lord
song.description: A medieval meme turned into dark cinematic R&B and dubstep, then tightened with micro-stutters before the shorter final edit glitches itself apart.
song.lineage: Meme seed → multiple Suno cuts → chosen dark R&B/dubstep direction → shortened final arrangement → surgical micro-stutter edits → continuous glitch-out final.

update.title: ’Twas the Tism, M’Lord
update.summary: The medieval meme song is live in its shorter final form: multiple Suno cuts narrowed into dark R&B and dubstep, then the weak stretches were cut out and the ending was rebuilt with micro-stutters and a full glitch-out.
update.cardSummary: The lyrics stayed medieval; the Halloween treatment is visual. The final release is the shorter hand-edited cut with micro-stutters and a glitching outro.
